title: Faulty planner triggers cascading downstream task failures
summary: A single agent fault propagates through orchestration to many dependent workflows.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The synthetic fixture uses a model to pursue a delegated goal and select or sequence actions that affect its environment.

LC.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: Attacker-controlled language enters through retrieved or ingested content (documents, web pages, email, files) and influences security-relevant behaviour.

CP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: Attacker-controlled context persists only in ephemeral session state (conversation buffer, in-memory working context, session-scoped cache), and testing confirms it is unreachable after the session boundary.

AP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: Compromised intent, instructions, memory, or authority crosses a trust boundary to other agents, other tenants, or downstream systems.

SR.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: A production-equivalent fixture records 18 successful independent episodes out of 30, each from clean state with the hard production budget of three attempts for one stable principal; one-sided 95% Wilson bounds are 0.451 and 0.733.

EX.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: A reachable extension is dynamic or unvetted, or its identity, callable operations, arguments, credentials, or authority are not independently constrained for the assessed deployment.

PT.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: Synthetic provider ref-provider and deployment model-ref-v1 are fixed under config-ref-v1 and changes are auditable, but provider-side artifact contents cannot be verified at runtime.

CA.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: No finite hard aggregate pre-execution ceiling exists for all attacker-reachable billable resources.

TD.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: A retrieval test cannot reconstruct ordered actions or bound affected principals.
